description:
The sales clerks in a bank can use their software frontend to receive the credit-scoring for a certain customer. 
This starts a process in the banking system which communicates with the agency in the background. 
This process sends a scoring request to the agency right after the beginning. 
Then, the Agency does a first quick scoring (level 1). 
This will often lead to an immediate result which is then returned directly to the banking system within seconds. 
The banking process presents the result to the clerk sitting at the frontend. 
Sometimes the scoring cannot be determined immediately and takes longer. 
In this case the agency informs the banking process of the delay and then starts the level 2 scoring (which can take up to a couple of minutes). 
After the scoring result is determined, the information is sent back to the banking process. 
The banking process displays a message to the clerk when he receives information about the delay to check again later. 
As soon as the result arrives, it can be seen at the frontend.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_CreditScoring"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/credit-scoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FrontendRequest" name="Frontend credit-scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AgencyRequest" name="Agency scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ImmediateResult" name="Immediate credit-scoring result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DelayNotification" name="Scoring delay notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Level2Result" name="Level 2 credit-scoring result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CheckLater" name="Check again later message"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FrontendImmediateResult" name="Immediate result for frontend"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FrontendLevel2Result" name="Level 2 result for frontend"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CreditScoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Frontend" name="Sales clerk frontend"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_BankingSystem" name="Banking system" processRef="Process_BankingSystem"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Agency" processRef="Process_Agency"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FrontendRequest"
                      name="Credit-scoring request"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Frontend"
                      targetRef="Start_BankingRequest"
                      messageRef="Message_FrontendRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AgencyRequest"
                      name="Scoring request"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendAgencyRequest"
                      targetRef="Start_AgencyRequest"
                      messageRef="Message_AgencyRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ImmediateResult"
                      name="Immediate scoring result"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResult"
                      targetRef="Catch_ImmediateResult"
                      messageRef="Message_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayNotification"
                      name="Scoring delay notification"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotification"
                      targetRef="Catch_DelayNotification"
                      messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Level2Result"
                      name="Level 2 scoring result"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result"
                      targetRef="Catch_Level2Result"
                      messageRef="Message_Level2Result"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CheckLater"
                      name="Ask clerk to check again later"
                      sourceRef="Task_InformClerk"
                      targetRef="Participant_Frontend"
                      messageRef="Message_CheckLater"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FrontendImmediateResult"
                      name="Present immediate result in frontend"
                      sourceRef="Task_DisplayImmediateResult"
                      targetRef="Participant_Frontend"
                      messageRef="Message_FrontendImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FrontendLevel2Result"
                      name="Present level 2 result in frontend"
                      sourceRef="Task_DisplayLevel2Result"
                      targetRef="Participant_Frontend"
                      messageRef="Message_FrontendLevel2Result"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_BankingSystem" name="Banking system credit scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_BankingRequest" name="Credit-scoring request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageDefinition_FrontendRequest" messageRef="Message_FrontendRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAgencyRequest" name="Send scoring request to agency" messageRef="Message_AgencyRequest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" name="Wait for immediate result or delay notification" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ImmediateResult" name="Receive immediate scoring result">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageDefinition_ImmediateResult" messageRef="Message_ImmediateResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_DelayNotification" name="Receive scoring delay notification">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageDefinition_DelayNotification" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InformClerk" name="Tell clerk to check again later"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Level2Result" name="Receive level 2 scoring result">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageDefinition_Level2Result" messageRef="Message_Level2Result"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DisplayImmediateResult" name="Present immediate result in frontend" messageRef="Message_FrontendImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DisplayLevel2Result" name="Present level 2 result in frontend" messageRef="Message_FrontendLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ImmediateResultPresented" name="Immediate result presented"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Level2ResultPresented" name="Level 2 result presented"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_01" sourceRef="Start_BankingRequest" targetRef="Task_SendAgencyRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_02" sourceRef="Task_SendAgencyRequest" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_03" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Catch_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_04" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Catch_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_05" sourceRef="Catch_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_DisplayImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_06" sourceRef="Task_DisplayImmediateResult" targetRef="End_ImmediateResultPresented"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_07" sourceRef="Catch_DelayNotification" targetRef="Task_InformClerk"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_08" sourceRef="Task_InformClerk" targetRef="Catch_Level2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_09" sourceRef="Catch_Level2Result" targetRef="Task_DisplayLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_10" sourceRef="Task_DisplayLevel2Result" targetRef="End_Level2ResultPresented"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Agency credit scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_AgencyRequest" name="Scoring request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageDefinition_AgencyRequest" messageRef="Message_AgencyRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level1Scoring" name="Perform level 1 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ImmediateDecision" name="Is the result determined immediately?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendImmediateResult" name="Send immediate scoring result" messageRef="Message_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDelayNotification" name="Inform banking system of scoring delay" messageRef="Message_DelayNotification"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level2Scoring" name="Perform level 2 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLevel2Result" name="Send level 2 scoring result" messageRef="Message_Level2Result"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ImmediateResultSent" name="Immediate result sent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Level2ResultSent" name="Level 2 result sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_01" sourceRef="Start_AgencyRequest" targetRef="Task_Level1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_02" sourceRef="Task_Level1Scoring" targetRef="Gateway_ImmediateDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_03" name="Result determined immediately" sourceRef="Gateway_ImmediateDecision" targetRef="Task_SendImmediateResult">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">immediateResultAvailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_04" name="Result not determined immediately" sourceRef="Gateway_ImmediateDecision" targetRef="Task_SendDelayNotification">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not(immediateResultAvailable)</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_05" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResult" targetRef="End_ImmediateResultSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_06" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotification" targetRef="Task_Level2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_07" sourceRef="Task_Level2Scoring" targetRef="Task_SendLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_08" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="End_Level2ResultSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
